Every page shows a published model, the experimental data it was validated
against, and a `pymrm` reproduction with a quantitative agreement metric.

**Filtering.** The category cloud below carries every classification axis at
once, using prefixed tags:

| Prefix | Meaning | Example |
|---|---|---|
| `sec:` | Catalog section (physical domain) | `sec:A` transport closures, `sec:D` fixed bed |
| `struct:` | Mathematical structure — *the axis to filter on if you want to reuse code* | `struct:S8` nested reactor–particle coupling |
| `tier:` | Standing in the literature | `tier:T0` canonical |
| `data:` | Provenance tier of the dataset | `data:tier1` open repository |
| `phase:` | Phase system | `phase:gas`, `phase:gas-solid` |

Structure codes are defined in
[`docs/taxonomy.md`](https://github.com/computational-chemical-engineering/pymrm-gallery/blob/main/docs/taxonomy.md).
Two pages sharing a `struct:` tag are solved by nearly the same pymrm code even
when their physics is unrelated — that is the intended route to reuse.
